goal: Add the recipes from recipes.jpg in Simple Gallery Pro to the Broccoli recipe app.
summary:
I added all three recipes from recipes.jpg to Broccoli, and each one shows in the recipe list. Two small differences from the image:

- **"Saute" has no accent.** The keyboard wouldn't type "é", so the soup's directions start with "Saute".
- **Extra sentences are joined in.** The last sentence of each recipe (e.g. "Garnish with fresh herbs…") sits on its own line in the image. I added it to the end of the directions after a space.

| Recipe | Servings | Time | Ingredients |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eggplant Parmesan | 8 servings | 10 mins | varies |
| Baked Cod with Lemon and Dill | 2 servings | 45 mins | subject to change |
| Chickpea Vegetable Soup | 2 servings | 2 hrs | as desired |

Each recipe also has the description and directions from the image. Broccoli already had a "Chickpea Vegetable Soup" with a different description, so there are now two with that name. I left the old one alone.
